changes.description: Retired. Superseded by observations, which this widget already declared as its replacementCandidate and which src/core.ts#validateWorkflow has migrated every saved places node into since adapter version 1 -- the node keeps its label, records and connections and is stamped sourceMigration so the Inspector says so. The widget's own release note already called it 'a legacy loading alias'; what changed on 2026-10-12 is that implementationStatus 'retired' is read, so the alias leaves the palette, the counts and the coverage ledger instead of sitting in them. It declared standardization 'example-specific' about itself -- one worked example's neighbourhoods -- which under the rule that no widget may be name-attached to a worked example is a self-reported failed admission.
